price.text_ja: 初回 USD 10 ＋合格後 USD 1,033。有効化後の合計 USD 1,043（追加オプション別）。

daily_dd.text_ja: 17時ESTの残高・有効証拠金の高い方から初期資金の4%相当額を引いた下限。
daily_dd.text_en: Higher balance/equity at 17:00 EST minus 4% of initial capital.

refund_after_pass.text_ja: 2026年1月21日以降購入は第4回出金で参加費返還。先に失格した口座は対象外。
refund_after_pass.text_en: Purchases on or after January 21, 2026: participation fee returned with the fourth payout; accounts disqualified beforehand are excluded.

ea.text_ja: 自己のEAは利用可。市販の合格用戦略・HFT等の禁止行為は別途適用。
ea.text_en: Own EAs allowed; commercial passing strategies, HFT and other prohibitions still apply.

copy.text_ja: 自己口座間のコピーは利用可。他者の口座共有やクロス口座ヘッジは禁止。
copy.text_en: Own-account copying allowed. Sharing others' accounts and cross-account hedging prohibited.

vps.text_ja: 複数トレーダーに紐づく共有デバイス/VPSは禁止。
vps.text_en: Shared devices/VPS linked to multiple traders prohibited.

profit_share.text_ja: 基本80%。有料アップグレード・違反時減額は別。
profit_share.text_en: Base 80%; paid upgrades and breach-related reductions separate.

payout_interval.text_ja: オンデマンド申請（資格条件達成後）。

price.text_ja: 初回掲載額 USD 5 ＋合格後有効化費。表示額だけが総額ではない。
price.text_en: Initial listed USD 5 plus post-pass activation fee. Listed amount alone is not total.

ea.text_ja: 手動戦略のリスク・数量管理、分析等の補助のみ。独立発注や全部/一部自動売買は禁止。未申告EAは停止対象。
ea.text_en: Only support for manual strategies, such as risk/size management or analysis. Independent order entry or fully/partly automated trading prohibited. Undeclared EAs may cause suspension.

copy.text_ja: 自己/他者口座のコピーには明示の許可が必要。
copy.text_en: Express permission required to copy own/others' accounts.

vps.text_ja: VPN/VPSは事前通知し、IPと口座の関連を伝える条件で利用可能。
vps.text_en: VPN/VPS allowed with prior notice and disclosure of the IP/account relationship.

ip.text_ja: 旅行も事前通知と航空券・予約等の証拠が必要。未通知利用はsoft breachの対象。
ip.text_en: Travel requires prior notice and evidence such as tickets/reservations. Unnotified use may be a soft breach.

consistency.text_ja: 日本語FAQ（13645496・一貫性ルール記事17462703）：ファンデッド口座に一貫性35%（評価フェーズには記載なし）。英語FAQ：ファンデッドは30%、購入時に解除可。日本語版と英語版で異なり、どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
consistency.text_en: Japanese FAQ (13645496, consistency article 17462703): 35% consistency on the funded account (none stated for the evaluation phase). English FAQ: 30% when funded, removable at checkout. The two versions differ and FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

consistency.text_ja: 日本語FAQ：ファンデッド口座に一貫性35%（評価フェーズは対象外。一貫性ルール記事17462703の対象：フラッシュ、即時チャレンジ（有効選択時）、ライト1/2ステップ、1/2ステップ、5,000万円口座。追加ルール記事13645541にも「すべてのファンデッド口座に適用」と記載。公式Xの2026-10-13告知は提出者確認）。英語FAQ：$300K未満のこのプランは一貫性ルールなし。日本語版と英語版で異なり、どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
consistency.text_en: Japanese FAQ: 35% consistency on funded accounts (not in evaluation; consistency article 17462703 lists Flash, Instant when enabled, LITE 1/2-Step, 1/2-Step and ¥50M accounts; additional-rules article 13645541 also says all funded accounts; the 13 Oct 2026 official X post is per the submitter). English FAQ: no consistency rule for this program below $300K. The two versions differ and FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

consistency.text_ja: 日本語FAQ：ファンデッド口座に一貫性35%（評価フェーズは対象外。一貫性ルール記事17462703の対象：フラッシュ、即時チャレンジ（有効選択時）、ライト1/2ステップ、1/2ステップ、5,000万円口座。追加ルール記事13645541にも「すべてのファンデッド口座に適用」と記載。公式Xの2026-10-13告知は提出者確認）。英語FAQ：$300K未満のこのプランは一貫性ルールなし。日本語版と英語版で異なり、どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
consistency.text_en: Japanese FAQ: 35% consistency on funded accounts (not in evaluation; consistency article 17462703 lists Flash, Instant when enabled, LITE 1/2-Step, 1/2-Step and ¥50M accounts; additional-rules article 13645541 also says all funded accounts; the 13 Oct 2026 official X post is per the submitter). special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage

Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

price.text_ja: 掲載価格 USD 1099（購入時に公式で確認）
price.text_en: Listed price USD 1099 (confirm officially at purchase)

ea.text_ja: 手動戦略のリスク・数量管理、分析等の補助のみ。独立発注や全部/一部自動売買は禁止。未申告EAは停止対象。
ea.text_en: Only support for manual strategies, such as risk/size management or analysis. Independent order entry or fully/partly automated trading prohibited. Undeclared EAs may cause suspension.

copy.text_ja: 自己/他者口座のコピーには明示の許可が必要。
copy.text_en: Express permission required to copy own/others' accounts.

vps.text_ja: VPN/VPSは事前通知し、IPと口座の関連を伝える条件で利用可能。
vps.text_en: VPN/VPS allowed with prior notice and disclosure of the IP/account relationship.

ip.text_ja: 旅行も事前通知と航空券・予約等の証拠が必要。未通知利用はsoft breachの対象。
ip.text_en: Travel requires prior notice and evidence such as tickets/reservations. Unnotified use may be a soft breach.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 評価は口座資金の1%以上の利益日が3日必要。ファンデッドは日本語FAQと英語FAQで条件が異なります。日本語FAQ：最低3取引日。追加ルール記事13645541は「ライト（1ステップ・2ステップ）の5,000万円口座は標準の3日」と記載（サイトの$300K列は日本語FAQの5,000万円口座に、口座サイズの並び順で対応させた推定。公式の換算表示はない）。1日単位でも全体でも利益目標なし。英語FAQ（2026-10-08頃改定）：前回出金以降、確定損益が1%以上の日が5日（$300K口座は5日）。どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: Evaluation: three profitable days ≥1% of account size. Funded: the Japanese and English FAQs differ. Japanese FAQ: minimum 3 trading days; additional-rules article 13645541 states that LITE (1-Step and 2-Step) ¥50M accounts keep the standard 3 days (the site's $300K column is matched to the Japanese FAQ's ¥50M account by size order; FundedElite publishes no conversion). No daily or overall profit target. English FAQ (revised around 8 Oct 2026): 5 days with closed P&L ≥1% since the last payout ($300K accounts need 5 days). FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

consistency.text_ja: 日本語FAQ：ファンデッド口座に一貫性35%（評価フェーズは対象外。一貫性ルール記事17462703の対象：フラッシュ、即時チャレンジ（有効選択時）、ライト1/2ステップ、1/2ステップ、5,000万円口座。追加ルール記事13645541にも「すべてのファンデッド口座に適用」と記載。公式Xの2026-10-13告知は提出者確認）。英語FAQ：$300K口座は60%。日本語版と英語版で異なり、どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
consistency.text_en: Japanese FAQ: 35% consistency on funded accounts (not in evaluation; consistency article 17462703 lists Flash, Instant when enabled, LITE 1/2-Step, 1/2-Step and ¥50M accounts; additional-rules article 13645541 also says all funded accounts; the 13 Oct 2026 official X post is per the submitter). English FAQ: 60% for $300K accounts. The two versions differ and FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

consistency.text_ja: 日本語FAQ：ファンデッド口座に一貫性35%（評価フェーズは対象外。一貫性ルール記事17462703の対象：フラッシュ、即時チャレンジ（有効選択時）、ライト1/2ステップ、1/2ステップ、5,000万円口座。追加ルール記事13645541にも「すべてのファンデッド口座に適用」と記載。公式Xの2026-10-13告知は提出者確認）。英語FAQ：$300K未満のこのプランは一貫性ルールなし。日本語版と英語版で異なり、どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
consistency.text_en: Japanese FAQ: 35% consistency on funded accounts (not in evaluation; consistency article 17462703 lists Flash, Instant when enabled, LITE 1/2-Step, 1/2-Step and ¥50M accounts; additional-rules article 13645541 also says all funded accounts; the 13 Oct 2026 official X post is per the submitter). English FAQ: no consistency rule for this program below $300K. The two versions differ and FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

consistency.text_ja: 日本語FAQと英語FAQで異なります。日本語FAQ：一貫性ルール35%が標準。購入時に「無効」を選ぶと適用されないが、チャレンジ料金が30%高くなる（一貫性ルール記事17462703。公式Xの2026-10-13告知は提出者確認）。英語FAQ：Instantは25%。どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

consistency.text_ja: 日本語FAQと英語FAQで異なります。日本語FAQ：一貫性ルール35%が標準。購入時に「無効」を選ぶと適用されないが、チャレンジ料金が30%高くなる（一貫性ルール記事17462703。公式Xの2026-10-13告知は提出者確認）。英語FAQ：Instantは25%。どちらが適用されるか公式は明示していません（表示言語で適用条件が決まるわけではありません）。
consistency.text_en: The Japanese and English FAQs differ. Japanese FAQ: 35% consistency rule by default; choosing "disabled" at purchase removes it but makes the challenge fee 30% higher (consistency article 17462703; the 13 Oct 2026 official X post is per the submitter). special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. English FAQ (17437285): funded only, risk per instrument per trading day up to 50% of the daily loss limit (1.5% at 3%, 2% at 4%, 2.5% at 5%); a breach can close the funded account and forfeit its profit (reset available from the dashboard). Both versions measure risk by the furthest SL ever set or, without an SL, the worst adverse price, counted on the closing day even if the trade closed in profit. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)
special_rules.text: English FAQ: a funded account moves to the Live Trading Programme automatically at the 4th consecutive payout on the same account (earlier at the risk team's discretion). That pending payout is not paid as a reward; it becomes the live account's starting balance. The live max drawdown is set from trading history. Not verified in the Japanese FAQ.

special_rules.title: Minimum holding time
special_rules.text: Standard three minutes; 30 seconds with purchased scalping option. Losing trades also count in funded stage. Check thresholds, split reductions and resets officially.

special_rules.title: Profitable trades also consume the risk allowance · funded stage
special_rules.text: Japanese FAQ (announced 13 Oct 2026): risk on a single instrument in one trading day is capped at 1% of the initial balance; instruments tracking the same asset (e.g. XAUUSD and XAUEUR, an index and its future) are combined; applies to every phase, challenge and funded (changed from "50% of the daily loss limit"). On violation, the challenge stage gets a warning first and a breach only if it continues; the funded stage is a soft breach requiring a soft-breach reset. FundedElite does not state which applies (the display language does not determine which conditions apply).

special_rules.title: Hedging prohibited within and across accounts
special_rules.text: Hedging is prohibited within one account and across prop accounts, broker accounts or other prop firms.

special_rules.title: Weekend holding does not permit weekend SL/TP execution
special_rules.text: Without the weekend-trading add-on selected at purchase, opening or closing trades on Saturday/Sunday is prohibited, including SL/TP fills. Holding Friday to Monday and modifying SL/TP are permitted. Violations can terminate the account; funded-stage violations entail reset and forfeiture of current profit. The add-on permits weekend orders and execution.

special_rules.title: Automatic move to live at the 4th consecutive payout (English FAQ)

price.text_ja: 初回USD5＋合格後有効化費。初回額は総額ではない。購入時の別途費用を確認。
price.text_en: Initial USD5 plus post-pass activation fee; initial amount is not total. Check additional purchase fees.

profit_target.text_ja: 評価3%。現行適用版を確認。

ea.text_ja: EAは条件付き。市販/第三者EA、HFT/金裁定、段階間で自動/手動を切替える回避は禁止。ソース証明を求められる場合あり。
ea.text_en: EAs conditional. Commercial/third-party EAs, HFT/gold arbitrage, or switching automatic/manual trading between stages to evade rules are prohibited. Source-code proof may be required.

copy.text_ja: Funded→評価、評価→評価のコピーは禁止。口座内を含むヘッジも禁止。
copy.text_en: Copying between your own GFT accounts is allowed (funded↔funded, challenge↔challenge, challenge↔funded; announced 6 Oct 2026). Copying another trader's trades, or between a GFT account and a personal broker account or another prop firm's account, is not allowed. The dashboard GOAT Trade Copier is allowed; other copiers running on a VPS or hosted environment are not. Hedging, including within one account, remains prohibited.

vps.text_ja: 2026年8月12日以降購入はVPS禁止。以前の購入は別条件。EAの可否とは別。
vps.text_en: From 6 Oct 2026, using VPNs, VPSs, proxies or remote/hosted environments during trading is prohibited on all accounts, including existing ones. Detection is a straight breach and payouts from that activity are not eligible. Exceptions: (1) the GOAT Trade Copier in the dashboard (cloud-based); (2) a VPN used only to connect to the server at first login and disconnected before trading. Other copiers running on a VPS or hosted environment are prohibited.

ip.text_ja: 本人のみ利用。VPNは証明を求められる場合あり。旅行前通知は強く推奨されるが一律事前許可義務と変換しない。
ip.text_en: Owner-only use. Purchase and trading regions should stay reasonably consistent; repeated regional changes may trigger review. Informing support before travel is strongly recommended (travel documents may be requested). VPNs during trading are prohibited on all accounts from 6 Oct 2026 (see VPS).

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 9月5日以降の合格後条件は5日。旧3日と区別し、利益基準の適用は公式確認。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: Funded terms from September 5 require five days, distinct from the former three; confirm applicable profit thresholds officially.

profit_share.text_ja: 基本80%。有料100%や初回オンデマンド40%の優先関係は別途確認。
profit_share.text_en: Base 80%. Priority between paid 100% and first on-demand 40% needs separate confirmation.

payout_interval.text_ja: 基本14日。利益日/一貫性/KYC条件も必要。初回の処理時計はKYC後からで、14日で着金ではない。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard 14 days plus profitable-day/consistency/KYC conditions. First processing clock starts after KYC; not receipt in 14 days.

payout_limit.text_ja: 方法別：銀行USD10,000、Skrill USD5,000、暗号資産USD3,000/申請。Riseの方法上限なしはプラン総上限なしではない。最低USD100。
payout_limit.text_en: Per request: bank USD10,000, Skrill USD5,000, crypto USD3,000. No Rise-method cap does not mean no plan cap. Minimum USD100.

consistency.text_ja: 9月5日以降30%。旧20%とは別。
consistency.text_en: 30% from September 5; separate from the former 20%.

special_rules.title: 3% reward processing fee
special_rules.text: All rewards carry a 3% processing fee, calculated on the final reward after the profit split and any deductions. Changed from 2% around 20 Sep 2026 (date per the ledger).

price.text_en: Listed fee USD 2,130. Coupons/add-ons/platform differences separate.

sources.evidence_scope: Official refund page and conditional fee return boundary batch193

refund_after_pass.text_en: Conditional fee return at fourth payout, separate from cancellation refunds.

ea.text_ja: EAは条件付き。市販/第三者EA、HFT/金裁定、段階間で自動/手動を切替える回避は禁止。ソース証明を求められる場合あり。
ea.text_en: EAs conditional. Commercial/third-party EAs, HFT/gold arbitrage, or switching automatic/manual trading between stages to evade rules are prohibited. Source-code proof may be required.

copy.text_ja: Funded→評価、評価→評価のコピーは禁止。口座内を含むヘッジも禁止。
copy.text_en: Copying between your own GFT accounts is allowed (funded↔funded, challenge↔challenge, challenge↔funded; announced 6 Oct 2026). Copying another trader's trades, or between a GFT account and a personal broker account or another prop firm's account, is not allowed. The dashboard GOAT Trade Copier is allowed; other copiers running on a VPS or hosted environment are not. Hedging, including within one account, remains prohibited.

vps.text_ja: 2026年8月12日以降購入はVPS禁止。以前の購入は別条件。EAの可否とは別。
vps.text_en: From 6 Oct 2026, using VPNs, VPSs, proxies or remote/hosted environments during trading is prohibited on all accounts, including existing ones. Detection is a straight breach and payouts from that activity are not eligible. Exceptions: (1) the GOAT Trade Copier in the dashboard (cloud-based); (2) a VPN used only to connect to the server at first login and disconnected before trading. Other copiers running on a VPS or hosted environment are prohibited.

ip.text_ja: 本人のみ利用。VPNは証明を求められる場合あり。旅行前通知は強く推奨されるが一律事前許可義務と変換しない。
ip.text_en: Owner-only use. Purchase and trading regions should stay reasonably consistent; repeated regional changes may trigger review. Informing support before travel is strongly recommended (travel documents may be requested). VPNs during trading are prohibited on all accounts from 6 Oct 2026 (see VPS).

payout_interval.text_ja: 基本14日。利益日/一貫性/KYC条件も必要。初回の処理時計はKYC後からで、14日で着金ではない。

sources.evidence_scope: 48fee rows linked to existing seven model guides

payout_interval.text_en: Standard 14 days plus profitable-day/consistency/KYC conditions. First processing clock starts after KYC; not receipt in 14 days.

payout_limit.text_ja: 方法別：銀行USD10,000、Skrill USD5,000、暗号資産USD3,000/申請。Riseの方法上限なしはプラン総上限なしではない。最低USD100。
payout_limit.text_en: Per request: bank USD10,000, Skrill USD5,000, crypto USD3,000. No Rise-method cap does not mean no plan cap. Minimum USD100.

special_rules.title: 3% reward processing fee
special_rules.text: All rewards carry a 3% processing fee, calculated on the final reward after the profit split and any deductions. Changed from 2% around 20 Sep 2026 (date per the ledger).

payout_limit.text_ja: 方法別：銀行USD10,000、Skrill USD5,000、暗号資産USD3,000/申請。Riseの方法上限なしはプラン総上限なしではない。最低USD100。
payout_limit.text_en: Per request: bank USD10,000, Skrill USD5,000, crypto USD3,000. No Rise-method cap does not mean no plan cap. Minimum USD100.

vps.text_en: From 6 Oct 2026, using VPNs, VPSs, proxies or remote/hosted environments during trading is prohibited on all accounts, including existing ones. Detection is a straight breach and payouts from that activity are not eligible. Exceptions: (1) the GOAT Trade Copier in the dashboard (cloud-based); (2) a VPN used only to connect to the server at first login and disconnected before trading. funded_profit_target.text_ja: 初回出金には6%の確定利益が必要。5利益日・一貫性条件も適用。
funded_profit_target.text_en: The first payout requires 6% closed profit; the 20% consistency rule also applies. The five-profitable-days requirement before the first payout was removed (announced 5 Oct 2026; effective date not stated). Application to existing accounts is unconfirmed.

payout_interval.text_ja: 公開規約では初取引から14暦日後に初回申請。5利益日・6%確定利益・一貫性条件も必要。次回期間は承認翌日から起算。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard 14-day cycle (first request 14 calendar days after the first trade). Requires 6% closed profit and the 20% consistency rule. The paid On-Demand Payouts add-on (25% of the base price) lets you request without waiting for the cycle (it does not mean instant payment). Removal of the five-profitable-days requirement: announced 5 Oct 2026, effective date not stated. Application to existing accounts is unconfirmed.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低出金 USD 100。 公開規約では月間の累計出金上限なし。ただし最低出金額・各サイクルの資格条件・一貫性・DD条件は適用。

sources.evidence_scope: Live terms section 7.6.5, monthly aggregate cap only; not per-request maximum

consistency.text_ja: Boltは最高利益日が累計利益の20%以下。超える場合は追加利益で条件を満たしてから出金申請。
consistency.text_en: Bolt: best-day profit must be ≤20% of cumulative profit. If exceeded, earn enough additional profit before requesting payout.

daily_dd.text_ja: 日次損失上限3%（2026年10月5日の公式記事で「変更なし」と記載）。計算基準の詳細は公式Bolt規約で確認。
daily_dd.text_en: Daily loss limit 3% (stated as unchanged in the official 5 Oct 2026 article). Check the official Bolt rules for how it is calculated.

max_dd.text_en: Maximum loss limit 6% (stated as unchanged in the official 5 Oct 2026 article). Check the official Bolt rules for the calculation method (static or trailing).

profit_share.text_ja: 基本80%。有料アドオン（基本価格の25%）で90%（2026年10月5日導入）。
profit_share.text_en: Standard 80%; 90% with the paid add-on (25% of the base price), introduced 5 Oct 2026.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低引出額USD50。別途、現在残高3%の利益が申請資格として必要。金額上限なしを意味しない。
payout_limit.text_en: Minimum withdrawal USD50 plus profit of 3% of current balance for eligibility. Does not mean no maximum.

leverage.text_ja: 全銘柄30倍（評価・有効化後）。
leverage.text_en: 30× on all instruments, during evaluation and after activation.

consistency.text_ja: 評価はなし。有効化後は最大利益日が総利益の25%以下で出金可能。超過は出金延期で直ちに閉鎖ではない。
consistency.text_en: None in evaluation. After activation, best-day profit ≤25% of total profit for payout. Excess delays payout, not immediate closure.

payout_interval.text_en: First request 14 days after receiving the Earning account, then every 14 days. Contractual reward decisions/payment deadlines are separate; not receipt within 14 days.

ea.text_ja: 自己EAは利用可。悪用・HFT・禁止手法を除く。

sources.evidence_scope: Saved region-specific capital/fee quote; final invoice unverified

price.text_en: Listed price USD 49. Regional official price; confirm discounts/final invoice separately.

daily_dd.text_ja: UTC00:00の有効証拠金を基準とする5%の日次下限。日中も有効証拠金で違反判定。
daily_dd.text_en: Daily floor: 5% below equity at UTC00:00; intraday equity determines breach.

max_dd.text_ja: 初期資金比10%の固定DD。
max_dd.text_en: Fixed loss limit: 10% of initial capital.

ea.text_ja: 自己作成または個別調整しロジックを理解したEAは可能。未調整の市販/公開ボット、他人のシグナル、第三者運用は禁止。
ea.text_en: Self-created or individually adjusted EAs with understood logic allowed. Unadjusted commercial/public bots, others' signals and third-party management prohibited.

copy.text_ja: 本人の外部ブローカー/他社口座からのコピーは可能。第三者運用・他人の同一取引・逆方向ヘッジは禁止。
copy.text_en: Copying from own external broker/other firm accounts allowed. Third-party management, identical trades by others and reverse hedging prohibited.

payout_interval.text_ja: 初回取引または前回成功した出金から14日。全ポジション決済とKYC等が必要。送金/着金時間とは別。
payout_interval.text_en: 14 days from first trade or previous successful payout. All positions must close; KYC and other conditions apply. Separate from transfer/receipt time.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低額：USD/EUR100、JPY20,000、CZK2,000。400K EUR Proは別途USD/EUR120の例外。最大出金額なしとは推測しない。
payout_limit.text_en: Minimum USD/EUR100, JPY20,000, CZK2,000. 400K EUR Pro exception: USD/EUR120. We do not assume there is no maximum payout.

leverage.text_ja: FX/金銀100倍、指数50倍、その他商品20倍、BTC2倍、その他暗号資産1倍。条件付きCR減額は別。
leverage.text_en: FX/gold/silver 100×; indices 50×; other commodities 20×; BTC 2×; other crypto 1×. Conditional CR reductions are separate.

consistency.text_ja: リスク審査によりCR1/CR2が個別適用される場合あり。CR1はリスク1%・配分15ポイント減、CR2はさらに日次利益1%上限・倍率減・配分30ポイント減等。全口座の標準条件ではない。
consistency.text_en: Risk review may individually apply CR1/CR2. CR1: 1% risk and a 15-point split reduction. CR2 additionally includes a 1% daily profit cap, lower leverage and a 30-point split reduction. Not standard for all accounts.

copy.text_ja: 本人の外部ブローカー/他社口座からのコピーは可能。第三者運用・他人の同一取引・逆方向ヘッジは禁止。
copy.text_en: Copying from own external broker/other firm accounts allowed. Third-party management, identical trades by others and reverse hedging prohibited.

payout_interval.text_ja: 初回取引または前回成功した出金から14日。全ポジション決済とKYC等が必要。送金/着金時間とは別。

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低額：USD/EUR100、JPY20,000、CZK2,000。400K EUR Proは別途USD/EUR120の例外。最大出金額なしとは推測しない。
payout_limit.text_en: Minimum USD/EUR100, JPY20,000, CZK2,000. 400K EUR Pro exception: USD/EUR120. We do not assume there is no maximum payout.

leverage.text_ja: FX/金銀100倍、指数50倍、その他商品20倍、BTC2倍、その他暗号資産1倍。条件付きCR減額は別。
leverage.text_en: FX/gold/silver 100×; indices 50×; other commodities 20×; BTC 2×; other crypto 1×. Conditional CR reductions are separate.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 30日周期に5日、各日初期資金0.25%以上の利益。出金で周期リセット、未達は口座終了。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: [Purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026] No minimum profitable days requirement. [Purchased before 8 Oct 2026 (old article)] 5 days with profit ≥0.25% of the starting balance in every 30-day period; failing it terminates the account. Announced 5 Oct 2026 (official X; date/time per the submitter). The official help centre applies the new article to accounts purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026 and the old article (v2) to accounts purchased before 8 Oct 2026 (those keep the old-article rules). Whether existing accounts will be migrated to the new rules is unconfirmed.

sources.evidence_scope: Applies to Instant Funding purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026: "Profit Split: 100% ... Every Instant Funding account comes with a 100% profit split"
Applies to purchases before 8 Oct 2026: "default profit split of 90% ... add-ons ... increase the profit split to 100%"

profit_share.text_en: [Purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026] 100% (included on every Instant account). [Purchased before 8 Oct 2026 (old article)] Base 90%, raisable to 100% with a checkout add-on. The official help centre applies the new article to purchases from 8 Oct 2026 and the old article (v2) to earlier purchases. Whether existing accounts will be migrated to the new rules is unconfirmed.

consistency.text_ja: 最大利益日÷純利益が15%以下。部分決済は最終決済日に計上。最大損失取引対最大利益取引/日の別ルールは公式相違あり。
consistency.text_en: Largest profit day ÷ total profit ≤15% (payout condition); partial closes count on the day the position is fully closed. The 15% rule appears in the official help articles for both purchases from 8 Oct 2026 and earlier purchases. The separate biggest-loss vs biggest-win rule was removed (announced 5 Oct 2026 on official X; date/time per the submitter). Purchases before 8 Oct 2026 also have 15% under the old article. Whether existing accounts will be migrated to the new rules is unconfirmed.

payout_interval.text_ja: 【2026年10月8日以降の購入分】On-Demand出金が全Instant口座に付帯（固定周期なし）。申請条件：残高が初期資金を3.5%以上上回る（3%の安全クッション＋出金可能利益0.5%）、一貫性15%以下、3%のクッションを口座に残す、保有ポジション・待機注文なし。【10月8日より前の購入分（旧記事）】標準は7日周期（初回は初取引から7日後、2026年6月29日告知）。On-Demand出金は追加オプションで、一貫性と3%クッションの条件は必要。告知日：2026年10月5日（公式X、日時は提出者確認）。公式ヘルプは新記事を「2026年10月8日以降の購入分」、旧記事（v2）を「10月8日より前の購入分」に適用と記載（10月8日より前の購入分は旧記事のルール）。既存口座を新ルールへ移行させるかは未確認。
payout_interval.text_en: [Purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026] On-Demand Payouts included on every Instant account (no fixed cycle). To request: balance at least 3.5% above the initial account size (3% safety cushion + 0.5% withdrawable profit), consistency ≤15%, the 3% cushion kept in the account, and no open positions or pending orders. [Purchased before 8 Oct 2026 (old article)] Standard 7-day cycle (first payout 7 days after the first trade; announced 29 Jun 2026); On-Demand Payout is an add-on that still requires the consistency and 3% cushion conditions. Announced 5 Oct 2026 (official X; date/time per the submitter). The official help centre applies the new article to accounts purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026 and the old article (v2) to accounts purchased before 8 Oct 2026 (those keep the old-article rules). Whether existing accounts will be migrated to the new rules is unconfirmed.

special_rules.title: Volume-weighted average holding time
special_rules.text: Volume-weighted average holding time must be ≥2 minutes: sum(minutes × volume) ÷ total volume. Repeated funded trades ≤15 seconds have a separate HFT rule. Not a simple average or a two-minute minimum for every trade.

price.text_ja: 公式ルールブック掲載費用 USD 1,998。最終決済額・決済通貨は購入画面で確認。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

price.text_en: Official rulebook fee USD 1,998. Confirm final amount/payment currency at checkout.

profit_target.text_ja: 評価利益目標 10%。含み損益を含む有効証拠金で判定。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

profit_target.text_en: Evaluation profit target 10%, assessed on equity including floating P&L.

daily_dd.text_ja: 日次3%。00:00 UTC時点の確定残高×(1−3%)が下限。含み損益込みの有効証拠金が下限に触れると違反。2026年7月27日版の算式で、口座適用版を確認。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

daily_dd.text_en: Daily 3%. Floor: closed balance at 00:00 UTC × (1 − 3%). Equity including floating P&L touching floor is a breach. Formula dated July 27, 2026; check applicable account version.

max_dd.text_ja: 初期資金比6%の固定DD。下限への接触で違反。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

max_dd.text_en: Fixed loss limit: 6% of initial capital; touching the floor is a breach.

refund_after_pass.text_ja: 有効化後は返金なし。合格・不合格を問わない。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

refund_after_pass.text_en: No refund after activation, whether passed or failed.

funded_profit_target.text_ja: 合格後の利益目標なし。出金条件は別。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

funded_profit_target.text_en: No funded profit target. Payout conditions separate.

profit_share.text_ja: 基本80%。KYC・契約上の審査条件に従う。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

profit_share.text_en: Base 80%, subject to KYC and contractual reviews.

payout_interval.text_ja: オンデマンド申請、最低待機期間なし。全ポジション決済後に利益全額を払出し（部分申請不可）。規定処理時間24時間以内は着金保証ではない。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

payout_interval.text_en: On-demand request with no minimum wait. Close all positions and withdraw all profit; no partial requests. Stated processing within 24 hours is not a receipt guarantee.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低申請額USD20、申請回数制限なし。回数制限と金額上限は別で、金額上限なしとは推測しない。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

payout_limit.text_en: Minimum request USD20; no request-count limit. Count limits differ from amount caps; we do not assume there is no amount cap.

ea.text_ja: ボット利用可。ただし安定性・協調取引・禁止手法の審査対象。市販ボットを無条件に許可する意味ではない。
ea.text_en: Bots permitted, but subject to stability, coordinated-trading and prohibited-strategy reviews. This is not unconditional permission for commercial bots.

ip.text_ja: 制限地域の回避にVPN等を使用することは禁止。共有機器・支払手段は通知が必要。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

ip.text_en: VPNs must not circumvent restricted regions. Shared devices/payment methods require notice.

leverage.text_ja: 銘柄別：SOL10倍、その他暗号資産2倍、株式4倍、SP500/XYZ100は10倍・その他指数5倍、金銀/CL/Brent8倍・その他商品5倍、FX25倍。BTC/ETHは公式内10倍/5倍競合のため非掲載。

sources.evidence_scope: Sections1-24 and disclosure, current rulebook substantive text read

leverage.text_en: SOL 10×; other crypto 2×; stocks 4×; SP500/XYZ100 10×, other indices 5×; gold/silver/CL/Brent 8×, other commodities 5×; FX 25×. BTC/ETH omitted due to official 10×/5× conflict.

special_rules.title: Discretionary funded-contract risk and consistency review
special_rules.text: Funded contract section 8 provides discretionary risk/consistency measures, metric exclusions and forfeiture of unpaid rewards. How this interacts with the rulebook's no-consistency-rule statement is unresolved; do not interpret as unconditional trading/payout permission.

sources.evidence_scope: Saved base quote, addons and discounts separate

price.text_ja: 基本掲載費用 USD 599。追加購入・クーポン価格は別。

sources.evidence_scope: Saved base quote, addons and discounts separate

price.text_en: Listed base fee USD 599. Add-ons/coupon prices separate.

refund_after_pass.text_ja: 評価の合格後・出金到達後も、チャレンジ購入費用の返還なし。取引開始前の購入取消・返金制度とは別の条件です。
refund_after_pass.text_en: No challenge-fee return after passing or reaching payout. Cancellation/refund before trading has separate conditions.

ea.text_ja: MT5のEAは可能。固有/個別設定、戦略合計400K、禁止手法などの条件あり。

sources.evidence_scope: EA scope and conflicting copy permission

ea.text_en: MT5 EAs allowed subject to unique/personal settings, a 400K total strategy cap and prohibited-strategy restrictions.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 評価各段階・各合格後出金周期で3利益日（0.5%以上）。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: Three profitable days (≥0.5%) per evaluation stage and funded payout cycle.

profit_share.text_ja: 基本80%。95%は有料追加機能。
profit_share.text_en: Base 80%; 95% is a paid add-on.

payout_interval.text_ja: 基本の初回申請は14日。7日・初回オンデマンドは有料選択で別。処理/着金とは別。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard first request after 14 days. Paid 7-day/first on-demand options separate. Not processing/receipt time.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低USD20。違反口座の未払報酬は失効し、残高が利益でも出金できるとは限らない。
payout_limit.text_en: Minimum USD20. Unpaid rewards on breached accounts are forfeited; a profitable balance does not ensure withdrawal eligibility.

leverage.text_ja: 一般上限：FX50倍、貴金属10倍、指数/商品15倍、暗号資産1倍。銘柄例外とRMG減額があり、全銘柄固定ではない。
leverage.text_en: General limits: FX 50×, precious metals 10×, indices/commodities 15×, crypto 1×. Symbol exceptions and RMG reductions apply; not fixed for every instrument.

special_rules.title: Net profit from trades lasting under three minutes
special_rules.text: If net profit from trades under three minutes is ≥30% of total net profit in the review period, it may be judged scalping, subject to profit removal, restrictions or suspension.

price.text_ja: 掲載費用 USD 80。割引/取消線価格の履歴と最終請求額は別。

sources.evidence_scope: Saved selected public quote; final customer invoice unverified

price.text_en: Listed fee USD 80. Discount/strikethrough-price history and final invoice separate.

daily_dd.text_ja: 17:00 EST時点の残高/有効証拠金の高い方から初期資金4%相当額を引く。DSTの補正は推測しない。
daily_dd.text_en: Higher balance/equity at 17:00 EST minus 4% of initial capital. We do not assume a DST adjustment.

max_dd.text_ja: 最高確定残高−初期資金6%が下限、初期資金で固定。全額引出は違反になり得るため余力が必要。
max_dd.text_en: Floor: peak closed balance minus 6% of initial capital, locked at initial capital. Full withdrawal may breach, so keep headroom.

refund_after_pass.text_ja: 購入費は原則返金不可。別制度として第3回報酬時に購入費100%相当ボーナス（NitroX等は除外）。
refund_after_pass.text_en: Purchase fee generally non-refundable. Separate bonus equal to 100% of purchase fee at third reward; NitroX and other exclusions apply.

ea.text_ja: 市販/第三者の共有ボット・戦略は禁止。独自EAの無条件許可を意味しない。

sources.evidence_scope: General restrictions inspected through IP rules

ea.text_en: Commercial/third-party shared bots and strategies prohibited. Not unconditional permission for proprietary EAs.

copy.text_ja: 本人の口座間のみ可能。他者シグナル・共有ボットは禁止。同銘柄の重複取引と公式コピー機能には別条件あり。

sources.evidence_scope: General restrictions inspected through IP rules

copy.text_en: Only between own accounts. Others' signals/shared bots prohibited. Same-instrument overlapping trades and official copy tools have separate conditions.

vps.text_ja: 購入・KYC・ダッシュボードでVPN/VPS使用は禁止。取引用VPNは非制限地域からの接続に限る。取引用VPSの全面許可は推測しない。
vps.text_en: VPN/VPS prohibited for purchase/KYC/dashboard. Trading VPN only from unrestricted regions. We do not assume VPS use for trading is generally permitted.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 合格後は5利益日（各0.5%以上）。評価の通常取引日とは別。

sources.evidence_scope: General restrictions inspected through IP rules

minimum_profit_days.text_en: Funded: five profitable days, each ≥0.5%; distinct from evaluation trading days.

profit_share.text_ja: 有料Nitroは最初の利益USD10,000まで90%、以降80%。無料口座は80%。
profit_share.text_en: Paid Nitro: 90% for first USD10,000 profit, then 80%. Free accounts: 80%.

payout_interval.text_ja: 条件達成後オンデマンド。ポジションを閉じ、引出控除まで取引を待つ。24営業時間保証は着金保証ではない。
payout_interval.text_en: On demand after qualifying. Close positions and wait for withdrawal deduction before trading. 24-business-hour guarantee is not receipt guarantee.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低初期資金1%（配分前）。USD1,000は24営業時間保証の適用上限で、出金最大額ではない。
payout_limit.text_en: Minimum 1% of initial capital before split. USD1,000 is the cap for the 24-business-hour guarantee, not the maximum payout.

price.text_ja: USD 177（公式掲載額。最終決済額は未確認）

ip.text_ja: 日本語規約では請求地域とIP地域の一致、IPマスキング禁止。英語版のより狭い迂回禁止表現を許可の根拠にしない。
ip.text_en: Japanese terms require billing/IP regions to match and prohibit IP masking. Narrower English circumvention wording is not evidence of permission.

profit_share.text_en: Base 80%.

payout_interval.text_ja: 初回28日、その後14日ごとの資格判定。条件不足なら14日延期。着金所要時間とは別。
payout_interval.text_en: First eligibility check at 28 days, then every 14 days. Unmet conditions defer it by 14 days. Separate from receipt time.

payout_limit.text_ja: 配分後報酬の初回上限：初期資金10%、第2回15%。Maximize段階はガイド上上限なし。JPY10,000未満等では14日延期。
payout_limit.text_en: Post-split reward caps: first 10% of initial capital, second 15%. Guide states no cap at Maximize. Amounts below JPY10,000 and other cases defer 14 days.

leverage.text_ja: FX50倍・商品10倍・株価指数5倍・暗号資産2倍。
leverage.text_en: FX 50×; commodities 10×; indices 5×; crypto 2×.

funded_profit_target.text_ja: 合格後の利益目標なし。出金の利益日・一貫性等の条件は別途適用。
funded_profit_target.text_en: No funded-stage profit target. Profitable-day, consistency and other payout conditions apply separately.

ea.text_ja: 自分で管理する自動売買の条件付き利用。第三者製・共有・レンタルEA、価格遅延等を狙う自動売買は禁止。Instantでは自分が所有・開発したEAに限られます。
ea.text_en: Self-managed automation is conditionally allowed. Third-party, shared or rented EAs and automation exploiting price delays are prohibited. Instant permits only EAs you own and develop.

copy.text_ja: 自分の口座同士も含め、コピー・ミラー取引、シグナル共有、協調取引は禁止。
copy.text_en: Copy/mirror trading, signal sharing and coordinated trading are prohibited, including between your own accounts.

vps.text_ja: VPN・VPSは条件付き。地域制限の回避や、他者と連携した取引を可能にする共有環境は禁止。
vps.text_en: VPN/VPS use is conditional. Circumventing geographic restrictions or sharing environments enabling coordinated trading is prohibited.

ip.text_ja: IP・端末・接続環境と取引パターンを審査。VPNで所在地を偽る行為や口座共有は禁止。
ip.text_en: IP, device, connection environment and trading patterns are reviewed. Misrepresenting location via VPN and sharing accounts are prohibited.

payout_interval.text_ja: 標準は14日間隔。初回は最低5利益日、2回目は3利益日、3回目以降は利益日数の最低条件なし。評価型は週次オプションあり。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard interval: 14 days. At least 5 profitable days for the first payout, 3 for the second, and no minimum profitable-day count from the third. Evaluation models offer a weekly add-on.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 利益日＝その日の利益が初期資金の0.5%以上。初回出金5日、2回目3日。評価通過の最低取引日数とは別条件。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: A profitable day earns at least 0.5% of initial capital. Five are required for the first payout and three for the second. This is separate from minimum evaluation trading days.

profit_share.text_ja: 標準80%。評価型には90%の追加オプションあり。
profit_share.text_en: Standard 80%; evaluation models offer a 90% add-on.

capital.text_ja: 初期資金 USD 5,000（シミュレーション口座）

price.text_ja: USD 74。公式表示の一回払い価格。割引・追加オプションは含めていません。購入画面で最終金額をご確認ください。
price.text_en: USD 74. Official listed one-time fee, excluding discounts and add-ons. Confirm the final amount at checkout.

profit_target.text_ja: 第1段階10%・第2段階5%。各段階で最低3取引日。
profit_target.text_en: Phase 1: 10%; Phase 2: 5%. At least 3 trading days in each phase.

max_dd.text_ja: 初期資金の10%・固定型。
max_dd.text_en: 10% of initial capital; static.

daily_dd.text_ja: 5%。前日の終了時有効証拠金を基準に日次の下限を設定。現在の含み損益も判定対象。
daily_dd.text_en: 5%. The daily floor is based on prior-day closing equity; current floating P/L is also included in the test.

copy.text_en: Copy/mirror trading, signal sharing and coordinated trading are prohibited, including between your own accounts.

vps.text_ja: VPN・VPSは条件付き。地域制限の回避や、他者と連携した取引を可能にする共有環境は禁止。
vps.text_en: VPN/VPS use is conditional. Circumventing geographic restrictions or sharing environments enabling coordinated trading is prohibited.

ip.text_ja: IP・端末・接続環境と取引パターンを審査。VPNで所在地を偽る行為や口座共有は禁止。
ip.text_en: IP, device, connection environment and trading patterns are reviewed. Misrepresenting location via VPN and sharing accounts are prohibited.

payout_interval.text_ja: 標準は14日間隔。初回は最低5利益日、2回目は3利益日、3回目以降は利益日数の最低条件なし。評価型は週次オプションあり。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard interval: 14 days. At least 5 profitable days for the first payout, 3 for the second, and no minimum profitable-day count from the third. Evaluation models offer a weekly add-on.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 利益日＝その日の利益が初期資金の0.5%以上。初回出金5日、2回目3日。評価通過の最低取引日数とは別条件。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: A profitable day earns at least 0.5% of initial capital. Five are required for the first payout and three for the second. This is separate from minimum evaluation trading days.

profit_share.text_en: Standard 80%.

capital.text_ja: 初期資金 USD 5,000（シミュレーション口座）

price.text_ja: USD 109。公式表示の一回払い価格。割引・追加オプションは含めていません。購入画面で最終金額をご確認ください。
price.text_en: USD 109. Official listed one-time fee, excluding discounts and add-ons. Confirm the final amount at checkout.

max_dd.text_ja: 最高の各日終了時有効証拠金から5%の追従型。日中の最高値では更新せず、下限が初期資金に達すると固定。
max_dd.text_en: 5% trailing from the highest end-of-day equity. Intraday highs do not update it; the floor locks when it reaches initial capital.

daily_dd.text_ja: 3%。前日の終了時有効証拠金を基準に日次の下限を設定。現在の含み損益も判定対象。
daily_dd.text_en: 3%. The daily floor is based on prior-day closing equity; current floating P/L is also included in the test.

leverage.text_ja: FX30倍／指数・商品10倍／暗号資産1倍
leverage.text_en: FX 30:1 / indices, commodities 10:1 / crypto 1:1

consistency.text_ja: 出金時、最大利益日の利益が総利益の20%以下。超えた場合は追加利益が必要。
consistency.text_en: At payout, best-day profit must be at most 20% of total profit. Additional profit is needed if exceeded.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低出金額は口座資金の1%。
payout_limit.text_en: Minimum payout: 1% of account capital.

funded_profit_target.text_ja: 合格後の利益目標なし。出金の利益日・一貫性等の条件は別途適用。
funded_profit_target.text_en: No funded-stage profit target. Profitable-day, consistency and other payout conditions apply separately.
